facts.text: Sam offered support to Evan during his job loss.

evidence.quote: Let me know if you need someone to talk to or if I can do anything to help. You'll get through this.

facts.text: Evan expressed appreciation for Sam's support.

Thanks, Sam. Your kind words and support mean a lot.
